rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Citing Articles 83 and 117 of the Constitution, Decree No. 580 of 12 May 1999, titled 'On the Chairman of the Government', announces the dismissal ('Объявляю об отставке') of the Government of the Russian Federation. It enters into force on signature and is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин', Moscow, Kremlin, 12 May 1999, No. 580.

rows.role_title: Исполняющий обязанности Председателя Правительства — Acting Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 2 entrusts the temporary performance of the duties of the Chairman of the Government to the First Deputy Chairman of the Government and Minister of Internal Affairs, Stepashin Sergei Vadimovich (printed in the accusative).

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Point 3 asks the members of the Government to continue performing their duties until a new Government is formed.
